totalScreens.description: Number of video panes to render. Defaults to 4.

rows.description: Number of grid rows. Defaults to 2.

columns.description: Number of grid columns. Defaults to 2.

sceneOrder.description: How each pane orders its playback list. Fewer repeats plays recently watched scenes last; the favour orders shuffle a random sample and bring matching scenes forward more often; the mix inserts an unwatched scene after every two favourites. Defaults to random.

options.label: Favour high ratings and O counts

spreadScenes.description: Keep scenes that share a performer or studio apart, in a pane and across split panes. Ignored when keeping the list order. Enabled by default.

splitScenes.description: Split loaded scenes across panes instead of reusing the same list. Defaults to false.

startMuted.description: Start every video muted. Enabled by default.

randomStart.description: Start each scene at a random timestamp after metadata loads. Enabled by default.

loopScenes.description: Loop each scene instead of advancing at the end. Enabled by default.

markerDuration.description: Seconds to play markers that do not have an end time. Defaults to 30.

pauseWhenHidden.description: Pause playback while the browser tab is hidden. Enabled by default.

showInMenu.displayName: Show DirtyMultiscreen in the Stash header
showInMenu.description: Add the DirtyMultiscreen grid button to Stash's utility navigation. When hidden, the player stays reachable by URL. Enabled by default.
